stats.done_summary: Task completed successfully. Analyzed 5000-frame industrial control telemetry trace using the laboratory-defined Temporal Stability Index (TSI). Following protocol_notes.md, split data into 5 blocks of 1000 frames, computed TSI for each block using compute_tsi from lab_metrics.py, and calculated mean TSI as the full-trace metric. Results: Mean TSI = 0.9190 (Block 1: 0.9171, Block 2: 0.9596, Block 3: 0.9077, Block 4: 0.8991, Block 5: 0.9117). Generated 5 visualization figures and wrote comprehensive research report to report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, and reproducibility information.
